defect_observations: Version: the copy read is the editor-hosted camera-ready extract of the volume file (PDF title 'Vol10-final2.pdf', created 2009-10-05, footer '(c) 2009 Elsevier BV'), with the volume pagination 625-650. The bib note (Romeijn2011InductiveLogicStatistics) calls it 'the volume editor's copy of the published chapter'; it should say it is the camera-ready extract of the 2009 volume file. This matches how the held Milton chapter of the same volume is registered.
Body 1496-1498 omits the source's forward pointer (p.643) that Section 11 introduces an alternative notion of confidence interval that avoids the dependence on the unknown true value.
Body 1138-1143 omits the source's remark (p.636) that de Finetti argued against multinomial hypotheses 'in line with the logical empiricists working in inductive logic'.

Body 1469-1471 says Romeijn 'attributes' maximum likelihood estimation to Fisher with reference to the 1956 book; the source (p.643) says the procedure was 'first devised by [Fisher, 1956]', a historical claim the body softens without noting it.

Body 1557-1558 reports n.5's 'chapter 15 of this volume' neutrally; the packet records Romeijn's own chapter as chapter 15, so the footnote's chapter number may be a misprint in the source. The body does not say this.
